title: Foundation stone for Parnell.
html_source: The foundation stone for the Parnell Monument was laid in 1899 near the Rotunda Hospital at the top of Sackville Street (now O'Connell Street), and was all that Bloom would see in 1904. In 1911, the completed monument created by sculptor Augustus Saint-Gaudens was unveiled.
